G1.text: Queue a cromford PR without asking when a lead MERGE or MERGE-WITH-NOTES binds the current head, the PR is clean, and no test was silently weakened. Never gh pr merge, never force-push. cromford only unless the operator extends it. Dead-shard ejects: @mergifyio queue.

G2.text: A BLOCK is three writes: PR comment, REQUEST_CHANGES review on the head, BLOCK verdict row. Re-post on a new head. Dismiss the CHANGES_REQUESTED review when the fix passes.

G3.text: No per-ticket budgets, no daily count caps. Tripwires alert and never stop a build.

G4.text: Selection, dedup, caps, scheduling, verification and retraction are deterministic. The model gets only judgment.

G5.text: Every lane has a manifest row in catalog/context-budgets.d/; context is composed per job, never accumulated.

G6.text: A lane never reads its own output. An alert only a human can clear is stated once, parked, and the wait is declared daily.

G7.text: All GitHub reads and writes go through gh api REST, bodies through files.

G8.text: Model selection is a DB row resolved at runtime. A hardcoded model id is a bug.

G9.text: Merges go through the queue. Knobs and flags are DB rows. A rollback is a row flip.

G10.text: A persisted "already paid" check runs before the billable call. ok/empty/failed, never two outcomes.

G11.text: Every table ships with its indexes named per query, an EXPLAIN test, and a retention rule. History rows are archived, never deleted.

G12.text: A red batch ejects every member. A green bystander goes back once per (PR, sha). A red head is never re-queued.

G13.text: The ladder is mechanical, then one fix round, then rebuild. A rebuild is never the first answer to a branch problem.

G14.text: A product choice inside a ticket belongs to the client or the operator, never to an agent.

G15.source: prompts/lead-review-checklist.md line 99; ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md "Speed and cost features: the proof is the metric"
G15.text: An INCONCLUSIVE evidence row caps the verdict at BLOCK. The fix is evidence, not a rebuild.

G16.text: Silent test weakening is an instant BLOCK.

G17.text: A limit that protects money, the machine or security stays hard. Everything else is a report.

G18.text: Kill before read. Claim before spend. decide is a pure function. NEVER lines refuse. One overrule demotes.

G19.source: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md "E2E / QA probes never touch client-visible surfaces", "probe the credential before building"
G19.text: A live probe that creates resources is a human call.

G20.source: ~/.claude/rules/metered-api-dedup.md "Billing-mode changes are architecture changes"; metered CI runners (docs/CI-RUNNERS.md)
G20.text: Spend caps and metered capacity (CI shards) change who pays. the operator decides.

G21.text: The case corpus: what a person decided, with what evidence, and what went to the operator.
